actual: AIstock is a single-user local platform, but every source PR is forced to wait for CodeQL verdict on the sole aistock-ci-security runner. A runner self-update or availability fault blocks all unrelated development for 30-60+ minutes even though GitHub branch protection requires only CI verdict. Move heavyweight CodeQL to one daily nightly full scan of latest main plus manual dispatch, remove pull_request and push triggers, stop the merge workflow from requiring CodeQL verdict, keep lightweight security checks inside CI verdict, update the sole development standard and machine policy consistently, and preserve fail-closed Nightly findings without adding high-risk PR classification. Do not modify backend, database, business modules, runtime services, dependencies, or other windows.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
